note: 15 §the verifier is a fortress (NEP-0012 law 1) · the journal's LINE bound (1 MiB · the same grain as the artifact bound) is a spec constant, and a line beyond it is refused BEFORE any parse — total refusal, never a truncate-and-continue. Line 1 is the real prologue of 001; line 2 chains onto it correctly and carries a 1048890-byte payload, so the only thing wrong with this journal is its size: the chain would hold. That is the point — the bound fires ahead of the walk, so a hostile line costs one length check and nothing else. Distinct from every walk verdict: `clean` · `finding` · `incomplete` · `forged` all mean the walk RAN.
